Details
  • Original code: https://github.com/cvg/megaflow at 2328f8bb2690
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://huggingface.co/Kristen-Z/MegaFlow/blob/b4c5c33800b8fa88e047d2eb70ae74b0feca606d/README.md
  • Training data: FlyingChairs (Freiburg), TartanAir, Freiburg SceneFlow (FlyingThings3D, Driving, Monkaa), MPI Sintel optical flow, KITTI stereo / optical flow 2012 / 2015, HCI HD1K optical flow benchmark (FlyingChairs, FlyingThings3D (part of SceneFlow), TartanAir, then a mix with Sintel, KITTI 2015 and HD1K, as upstream's README lists the training datasets)
  • Options: iters = 8 (>= 1)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, cudnn_hacc, raft_flow
  • Variants: megaflow
  • Outputs: flow
  • Input size: any H x W >= 64, padded to a multiple of 8
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): megaflow 1080x1920 (3.0 GiB peak allocated, 3.2 reserved)
  • megaflow 1080x1920, first call: portable + torch.compile 102 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 214 s (ONNX + engine).
  • megaflow original 1080x1920: the authors' mixed-precision option (bfloat16); upstream MegaFlow, num_reg_refine=8, README recipe: bf16 autocast
  • megaflow load / first call: original 9.56 s / 6.769 s, portable 1.96 s / 0.758 s (375x1242), kernels 7.1 s / 0.668 s (375x1242)
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Frames _10 -> _11 at full size against the flow_occ ground truth; EPE = mean of the per-pair mean end-point error, Fl-all = share of all valid pixels with an error > 3 px and > 5 % of the GT magnitude. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.002 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 0.003 and p99 <= 0.008 (absolute error of the output flow).

Limitations

  • Pairs only: upstream's multi-frame clips (temporal attention across more than two frames) and its point-tracking and chairs-things checkpoints are not exposed.
